result.question: Who were priests for the tribe of Dan?

readings.answer: Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons
readings.support: Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan

assessments.reason: Matches Judges 18:30 verbatim; identifying Jonathan son of Gershom (Moses’ grandson) and his sons as the priests is the same referent as the key.

result.reason: Judges 18:30 explicitly states Jonathan son of Gershom (of Moses) and his sons were priests for Dan.
